name: element reels
description: Spins elemental damage slots.
effect: Deals strength-based special damage to a random enemy. If at least two symbols match, the attack gains the corresponding element. If three symbols match, this overdrive hits all enemies. Red = Fire; Yellow = Lightning; Blue = Water; White = Ice.

name: attack reels
description: Spins multiple attack slots.
effect: Deals a varying amount of randomly distributed hits to enemy party. The amount of hits is determined by the slots. If three symbols match, the amount of hits gets doubled for a maximum possible amount of 12 hits.
unlock_condition: Appears as a prize in a blitzball tournament.

name: status reels
description: Spins status ailment slots.
effect: Deals strength-based special damage to a random enemy. If at least two symbols match, the attack inflicts the corresponding status ailments. If three symbols match, this overdrive hits all enemies. Skull = Sleep, Silence, Darkness, Poison; Arrow = Full Break; Hourglass = Petrification, Haste-removal and Delay.
unlock_condition: Appears as a prize in a blitzball league after unlocking Attack Reels and participating in 250 battles outside of the Monster Arena.

name: aurochs reels
description: Spins Aurochs custom slots.
effect: Combines the symbols of Element and Status Reels and adds an Aurochs Symbol into the Slots. Deals strength-based special damage to a random enemy. If at least two symbols match, the attack gains the corresponding effect. If three symbols match, this overdrive hits all enemies. Two or three Aurochs-Symbols result in the Aurochs Shot, which is a powerful attack without any side-effects.
unlock_condition: Appears as a prize in a blitzball tournament after unlocking Status Reels and participating in 450 battles outside of the Monster Arena.
